Name: Friendship Decay
Author: stardemod
Description:
Patch 1.07 introduced a bug where friendship stops decaying once it reaches maximum. [b]Unacceptable![/b] This mod reinstates the decay mechanic and adds more long-overdue fixes. Friendship decay has been accelerated, meaning simply gifting villagers an Iridium-Quality Rabbit Foot on their birthday will no longer suffice. Thanks to this mod, you no longer have to click through a cluttered mailbox filled with unwanted gifts.

Here's a list of fixes:
[list]
[*]Tripled decay rates.
[*]Decay never stops.
[*]Boyfriends and girlfriends will ghost you if friendship drops too low. (Still friendly)
[*]Friendship of pets can now decay.
[/list]
Have fun building friendship with all the villagers, especially the Dwarf or Leo. Friendship decay still doesn't occur when you interact with the villagers. Spouses won't file for divorce. Instead, you'll have to personally go to Lewis and pay up for it. Nothing for free here.

Finally, the game is playable. Glad to have helped.


[b]Default decay rates:
[/b]
Married over 2500 Friendship points
From -20/day to[b] -60/day[/b]

Married under 2500 Friendship points
From -22/day to [b]-60/day [/b]

Dating over 2500 Friendship points
From -0/day to [b]-24/day [/b]

Dating under 2500 Friendship points
From -10/day to [b]-24/day [/b]

Not dating over 2000 Friendship points
From -0/day to[b] -8/day [/b]

Not dating under 2000 Friendship points
From -2/day to [b]-8/day [/b]

Not romanceable over 2500 Friendship points
From -0/day to [b]-8/day[/b] 

Not romanceable under 2500 Friendship points
From -2/day to[b] -8/day [/b]

Pet bowl not filled
From -0/day to[b] -10/day[/b]


Special Mode [b]BURN_DOWN_THE_WORLD[/b]:

[list]
[*]Decay rates are influenced by your overall friendship level with all villagers. You could lose all friendship points at once.
[*]Decay never stops.
[*]Boyfriends and girlfriends will ghost you if friendship drops too low (they will be divorced).
[*]Friendship of pets can now decay.
[*]I don't even know if perfection is possible with this difficulty.
[/list]
[u]Decay rates:
[/u]
[list]
[*]The friendship decay ranges from[b] -0/day[/b] (no friendship points at all) to [b]-2749/day[/b] (when all villagers have maximum friendship)
[*]The pet friendship decay ranges from [b]0/day [/b](no friendship points at all) to [b]-1000/day[/b] (when pet has maximum friendship)
[/list]

[b]Configurations:[/b]
Adjust decay rates individually for spouses, love interests, and villagers. Additionally, you can disable breakups. To modify the configuration, start the game once, and then locate the config file inside the mod directory.
